_about: Head coaches tab lineups, built once by updater/coaches/lineups_hist.py: each NBL27 head coach's NBL seasons since 2015-16 (coaches/curated.json stints), rebuilt from the official play-by-play (nblR) and checked game by game against the official box scores; units = [player indexes, seconds, f, a, game indexes], f/a = pts, fga, fgm, tpa, tpm, fta, ftm, oreb, dreb, tov.
